title: colysis elliptica var. pothifolia
intro: Colysis elliptica var. pothifolia, commonly known as Pothifolia Fern, is a type of plant species belonging to the family Polypodiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include wound healing, antiseptic, and anti-parasitic effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These bioactive compounds are responsible for the plant's medicinal properties, making it a valuable resource in herbal medicine.
